# UpdateApply

> Tailor a resume for each job from one honest work profile. Private beta — join the waitlist at the marketing site. Signing up does not open the app.

## Site

- Homepage / waitlist: https://updateapply.com
- Product app (private beta, not for public indexing): https://app.updateapply.com

## Product

UpdateApply keeps one work profile, drafts a tailored resume from a pasted job description, lets you edit the draft, and downloads a PDF so you can apply on the employer’s site.
